name: Wings
lyricQuotes: Stuck inside these four walls / Sent inside forever

shortBio.en: McCartney-led UK rock/pop, 1971–1981. Band on the Run is the main post-Beatles reference; Linda McCartney and Denny Laine are the core partners.
shortBio.zh: McCartney 领衔的英国摇滚/流行，1971–1981。《Band on the Run》是后 Beatles 主要参照；Linda McCartney 与 Denny Laine 是核心伙伴。

body.en:
Wings formed in 1971 with Paul McCartney, Linda McCartney, and Denny Laine. Lineups shifted through the decade. Wild Life through Back to the Egg mix music-hall pop, hard rockers, and touring McCartney rebuilt after the Beatles.

Band on the Run (1973) reached #1 in the US and UK. In this person graph, Wings is the bridge page from Beatles to McCartney’s 1970s band work.
body.zh:
Wings 于 1971 年由 Paul McCartney、Linda McCartney 与 Denny Laine 组建，阵容在十年间有变。从《Wild Life》到《Back to the Egg》混合音乐厅流行、硬摇滚曲，以及 Beatles 之后 McCartney 重建的巡演。

《Band on the Run》（1973）登上英美专辑榜冠军。在人物图谱中，Wings 是 Beatles 到 McCartney 1970 年代乐队工作的桥页。

whyMatters.en: Paul McCartney’s 1971–81 band after the Beatles. Band on the Run (1973) reached US/UK #1 and remains the main Wings citation for stadium and pop songwriting under a new name.
whyMatters.zh: Paul McCartney 在 Beatles 之后 1971–81 年的乐队。《Band on the Run》（1973）登上英美榜冠军，是 Wings 在新名称下体育场与流行词曲写作的主要引用。

note.en: Title track from Band on the Run; three-part structure inside a radio-length single.
note.zh: 《Band on the Run》标题曲；电台长度单曲内的三段结构。

note.en: James Bond theme; George Martin orchestration with Wings rock sections.
note.zh: 詹姆斯·邦德主题曲；George Martin 配器与 Wings 摇滚段落。

note.en: From Wings at the Speed of Sound; disco-adjacent groove; US #1 single.
note.zh: 出自《Wings at the Speed of Sound》；偏 disco 的 groove；美国单曲榜冠军。

body.en:
McCartney forms Wings after the Beatles split and the solo album McCartney (1970). The initial core is Paul, Linda, and Denny Laine—sidemen chosen outside a star-supergroup frame.

Wild Life (1971) is loose and quickly recorded; tour rehearsals double as writing sessions. Maybe I’m Amazed (1970, solo) sets a vocal approach Wings continues.
body.zh:
Beatles 解散与 solo 专辑《McCartney》（1970）后组建 Wings。初始核心是 Paul、Linda、Denny Laine——伴奏人选不走明星超级组合路线。

《Wild Life》（1971）松散快录；巡演排练兼写歌。《Maybe I’m Amazed》（1970，solo）定下 Wings 延续的人声写法。

title.en: Band on the Run: Lagos sessions

body.en:
Recorded in Lagos with Paul, Linda, Denny Laine, and Denny Seiwell. The title track runs verse-chorus-suite sections in under five minutes.

Jet opens with snare crack and stacked backing vocals; Live and Let Die adds George Martin horn stabs. The album hit #1 in the US and UK.
body.zh:
于拉各斯与 Paul、Linda、Denny Laine、Denny Seiwell 录制。标题曲在五分钟内跑完主歌-副歌-组曲段落。

《Jet》以军鼓 crack 与堆叠和声开场；《Live and Let Die》加 George Martin 铜管刺击。专辑登上英美榜冠军。

title.en: Wings Over America and the end

body.en:
Expanded lineups add Joe English (drums) and Jimmy McCulloch (guitar). Wings Over America (1976) documents arena shows mixing Beatles catalog with new material.

Venus and Mars (1975) and London Town (1978) split between rockers and ballads. McCartney ends Wings in 1981 after further lineup changes and fallout from a marijuana arrest in Japan.
body.zh:
扩编加入 Joe English（鼓）与 Jimmy McCulloch（吉他）。《Wings Over America》（1976）记录体育场演出，混有 Beatles 目录与新曲。

《Venus and Mars》（1975）与《London Town》（1978）在摇滚曲与抒情曲之间分流。McCartney 于 1981 年在阵容继续变动与日本大麻案余波后结束 Wings。

body.en: Three-part structure inside a radio-length single. Core McCartney songwriting from the early Wings peak.
body.zh: 电台长度单曲内的三段结构。Wings 早期峰值时期的核心 McCartney 词曲。

body.en: Bond theme with George Martin orchestration and Wings rock sections. A pop-event single from 1973.
body.zh: 邦德主题曲，George Martin 配器与 Wings 摇滚段落。1973 年的流行事件单曲。

body.en: Disco-adjacent groove from Wings at the Speed of Sound. US #1 single in 1976.
body.zh: 出自《Wings at the Speed of Sound》的偏 disco groove。1976 年美国单曲榜冠军。

interviewQuotes.text: Wings was a band, not a solo disguise—though I wrote most of it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Paul McCartney

interviewQuotes.text: Band on the Run was made under pressure and it sounds like freedom.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Paul McCartney

label.zh: Band on the Run 核心

note.en: McCartney/Linda/Laine core through the Band on the Run peak years.
note.zh: McCartney/Linda/Laine 核心，贯穿 Band on the Run 峰值年份。

note.en: Multi-section pop-rock title track; US/UK #1 album.
note.zh: 多段体流行摇滚标题曲；英美专辑榜冠军。

note.en: Post-Beatles McCartney band; hit singles with suite-length ambition on key tracks.
note.zh: 后 Beatles 的 McCartney 乐队；热单写法，关键曲目带组曲长度。
